newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-NATAL HAMMER GRIQUAS 51-3.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NATAL HAMMER GRIQUAS 51-3.

text.p: Defending champions Natal retained their unbeaten record in the 1996 Currie Cup when they hammered Griqualand West 51-3 (halftime 32-3) in their quarter-final rugby match at King's Park on Saturday.

Although Natal's performance in the second half was erratic after they totally dominated the opening period, they finished in style with three tries in the last 10 minutes to advance to a home semi-final next Saturday against Free State.
With inspirational fullback Andre Joubert crossing twice, Natal scored seven tries in all while Griquas' only points came from a Franco Smith penalty kick.
Natal entirely dominated the first half with their forwards and backs linking well as possession was continually recycled.
Inside centre Thierry Lacroix scored after being put through by Andre Joubert.
Joubert went over twice before the break and James Small dived over for a soft try on the right wing after a two-man overlap.
Natal then survived a testing third quarter as the Griquas upped their game before centre Jeremy Thomson and replacement backs Joos Joubert and Robert du Preez all scored in the closing stages.

Natal - Tries: Thierry Lacroix, Andre Joubert (2), James Small, Jeremy Thomson, Joos Joubert, Robert du Preez. Conversions: Thierry Lacroix, Henry Honiball. Penalties: Honiball, Lacroix (2). Drop goal: Andre Joubert.
